informal_restatement.author: Formalia 维护者（据 formal-conjectures 文档注释翻译）
informal_restatement.text: 记 pₖ 为第 k 个素数。是否有无穷多个 n，使 (pₙ + pₙ₊₂) / 2 是素数？
informal_restatement.text_en:
Let $p_k$ be the $k$-th prime number.
Are there infinitely many $n$ such that $(p_n + p_{n+2}) / 2$ is prime?
